I was just doing what I was told in VR. And while I was doing my task in the VR, my mind keep amazed by this great VR tech. Basically all the effort the programmer made (graphics and details) to make everything looks so real. Its really AWESOME!!
My suggestion, I think it's a good idea to remind one more time, to anyone who participate in the research what this test about before we start the VR. Especially for people who never experiencing this awesome tech and has computer background like me. So we are not focusing on the details of VR tech (the mistake I did).
Because, I believe I can remember better, if I my mind was not distracted by the graphics, and how this VR tech works. So I can imagine, what I was doing in the VR, is actually the real thing.']

['wow, i found this really interesting, watching how my memory worked. I had absolutely no idea of the order of picking up any of the objects. I felt my memory was pretty good in remembering or identifying the objects in the rooms, but not so good on remembering the objects on the pillars. Anyway, hope you get some conclusive results from your study,
Many thanks for involving me.
Sue Wensor']
